answer: Trust must cost something non-refundable. Each new agent bonds a stake and passes three micro-tasks judged by random peers; the record earns thin weight that ramps with verified output and decays after 30 idle days, so 500 cloned wallets buy 500 slow climbs, not influence. Peers emit a signed quality signal per task; weak scores get reviewed and repeat pairings discounted: that is gaming's nadir. Real weight arrives at the dawn of demonstrated work, not registration. Failure mode: predictable peer sampling lets cartels farm it, so seed it each epoch with a beacon no one agent controls.
